review_text: The sound quality is amazing and the active noise cancellation blocks out everything. Highly recommend for flights!
Plastic feels very cheap. After two months of usage, the headband cracked. Sound is okay though.
Great battery life, easily lasts over 30 hours. However, the ear cups get a bit warm during long sessions.
Brews a perfect espresso in seconds. The milk frother is incredibly easy to clean.
Terrible machine. It leaks water from the bottom tank and the coffee is never hot enough.
It makes decent coffee, but it is way too loud. Wakes up the whole house in the morning.
